abstract: Alpha fetoprotein was demonstrated in 15 of 115 patients with histologically proved germinal testicular neoplasms. Alpha fetoprotein was detected in patients only with embryonal carcinoma and teratocarcinoma; determinations were negative in all cases of pure seminoma, teratoma, and choriocarcinoma. Of 15 patients having detectable alpha fetoprotein, 14 had Stage III disease and one had Stage II disease. When alpha fetoprotein is present, it usually heralds progression of the disease and therefore may serve as a valuable biologic marker to monitor response to therapy.
abstract_ja: 組織学的に確認された精巣の胚細胞腫瘍115例中15例で、αフェトプロテインが検出された。αフェトプロテインは胎児性癌と奇形癌の症例でのみ検出され、純粋セミノーマ、奇形腫、絨毛癌ではすべて陰性だった。αフェトプロテイン陽性の15例のうち14例は病期III、1例は病期IIであった。αフェトプロテインが存在する場合、通常は病勢の進行を示すため、治療効果をモニタリングする有用な生物学的マーカーとなりうる。
